# known-absent.reconbox3.txt — the REFERENCE-mode expected-absent set for the
# provisioned parity box, so the ratchet there compares against the right list
# instead of failing for a reason nobody needs to re-derive.
#
# PROVENANCE
#   host        reconbox3 (the phase-16 parity box)
#   date        2026-08-24
#   source      .planning/phases/16-live-run-observability-tool-contract-integrity/
#               16-06-PARITY.md §2.2 — "Realtools census — REFERENCE mode, the
#               first ever on a provisioned box"
#   census      TestRealToolArgVectors   present=30 skipped=9
#               TestRealtoolsVulnsPhase6 present=13 skipped=6
#               TestRealtoolsOSINTPhase7 present=11 skipped=14
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
#   16-04 seeded three known-absent lists into Go source. `smokeKnownAbsent` was
#   seeded from a provisioned box and turned out EXACTLY right; the vulns and
#   OSINT lists were derived on a developer laptop and did not match reconbox3 at
#   all, which is why Gate 13 FAILed there — the ratchet working, as 16-04
#   predicted. Three boxes have now produced three different censuses, so the list
#   is a property of a BOX and belongs in a per-box file, not in the binary.
#
# HOW TO USE
#   REALTOOLS_REFERENCE=1 \
#   REALTOOLS_KNOWN_ABSENT="$PWD/internal/core/backend/testdata/known-absent.reconbox3.txt" \
#     make realtools-args
#
#   The path must be ABSOLUTE (or relative to internal/core/backend/): `go test` runs
#   with the PACKAGE directory as its working directory, so a repo-relative path is
#   not found — and the reader refuses to fall back, so it fails loudly rather than
#   silently unenforcing the ratchet. That refusal is correct; this note exists so the
#   next person does not have to rediscover it.
#
#   Without REALTOOLS_KNOWN_ABSENT the compiled-in lists are used, unchanged.
#
# FORMAT
#   [<TestFunctionName>]      section per probe
#   <tool> = <reason>         one entry per tool; the reason is REQUIRED
#   # comment                 ignored
#
# BOTH RATCHET DIRECTIONS STILL BITE. A tool that is absent and unlisted fails
# (forward); a tool that is listed and present fails as stale. Seeding the list
# changes WHICH list is compared, never WHETHER it is compared.

[TestRealToolArgVectors]
arjun     = python tool, uv-installed; absent on reconbox3 2026-08-24
dnscewl   = repo-clone tool, not on PATH
p1radup   = python tool, uv-installed
regulator = repo-clone python tool, run via its own venv
subwiz    = python tool, uv-installed
subzy     = go tool; absent on reconbox3 (its production arg vector was ALSO wrong — fixed in 17-04)
urless    = python tool, uv-installed
wafw00f   = python tool, uv-installed
waymore   = python tool, uv-installed

[TestRealtoolsVulnsPhase6]
commix     = python tool, uv-installed; absent on reconbox3 2026-08-24
fray       = python tool from PyPI; absent on reconbox3
ghauri     = python tool, uv-installed; optional SQLi engine
gqlspection = python tool, uv-installed
sqlmap     = system/repo-clone tool; absent on reconbox3
testssl.sh = repo-clone shell tool; absent on reconbox3
